tasks.name: Sort the cozy toys
tasks.prompt: Drag each cozy toy to the right room basket.
tasks.hint: Sleepy things go to bedtime. Play things go to playtime.

tasks.name: Finish the room pattern
tasks.prompt: Pillow, lamp, pillow, lamp... what comes next?
tasks.success_text: Yes. Pillow keeps the pattern cozy.
tasks.retry_text: Let's watch the turn-taking pattern again.

tasks.name: Match the helper pairs
tasks.prompt: Match each house helper with what it uses.
tasks.hint: Find the helper that belongs with each item.

tasks.name: Choose the next cozy step
tasks.prompt: First we brush teeth. Then we put on pajamas. What comes next?
tasks.hint: Think of the next bedtime step after pajamas.
tasks.success_text: Yes. The cozy bedtime step comes next.
tasks.retry_text: Let's think about bedtime in order again.

tasks.name: Open the secret surprise
tasks.prompt: Drag the surprise bow onto Mimi's shining present stand.
tasks.hint: Place the bow on the shining present stand to open the surprise.
